title: Screeds & Underfloor Heating
activity: Floor screeds, UFH and Thermotec floors
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement
itp: SJWS-PGS-ZZ-ZZ-IP-X-00001 C03; -00002 C05; SJWS-LAC-XX-XX-IP-X-00001 C02; SJWS-ESC-05-XX-IP-X-00013 C01

questions.q: Slab levels checked and screed depths sufficient; floor draught-free?
Insulation laid with joints tightly butted; edge foam at all perimeters?
UFH pipes at 150 mm centres, flow around the outside of the room, ≥100 mm from floor boxes?
Manifold fixed (450 mm base to top fixing, 300 mm space for pump set)?
UFH pressure tested at 6 bar water pressure and kept under pressure during screeding?
Ask the fitter: What flatness and level tolerance are you laying to, and when was it pressure tested? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Joints and angles installed; mesh at mid-depth across bay joints?
Screed compacted, ruled to level and finished (float/trowel)?
No significant cracks or hollowness; moisture 75% RH or less before floor finishes?
Surface regularity: gap under a 2 m straightedge no more than 3 mm; level within ±7 mm of datum?

guide.title: Screed – EPR figures
rows: 3 mm max under a 2 m straightedge (anywhere)
C (5 mm indentation); plant rooms/storage B (4 mm)
laid in two layers, lower one roughened
75% RH or less on every reading

guideRS.title: Riding School – screed
rows: 2 mm under 3 m / 1 mm under 1 m

questions.q: Screed sound – no hollow spots, cracking or dusting when scratched?

notOk.t: Cracking through the screed beyond normal shrinkage
Acoustic resilient layer omitted or pierced by conduits
Trenches left hollow and screeded over
Manifold not level, not boxed in or not made good
UFH coverage short of the room / conduits not on drawings

ask.q: What flatness and level are you laying to?
ask.a: 3 mm under a 2 m straightedge; level as the datum (Riding School ±3 mm).

ask.q: When was the UFH pressure tested and is it still under pressure?
ask.a: 6 bar water, kept under pressure during screeding.

ask.q: When can floor finishes go on?
ask.a: Only when moisture readings show 75% RH or less.
